capabilities: Expose Obsidian CLI commands as REST HTTP endpoints
Run an MCP server for AI assistant integration
Create, read, search, and modify notes, properties, tags, and tasks over HTTP
Control plugins, themes, sync, publish, and workspaces remotely
Secure the server with API key authentication, localhost binding, and command blocklists
extras: Full user guide, API reference, MCP setup, and command reference are hosted on external documentation pages. The catalog listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian desktop v1.4.0+ with the CLI enabled in Settings > General > Advanced.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to control the vault programmatically from external scripts, tools, or AI assistants over standard HTTP.

requires.name: MCP client such as Claude Desktop (needs mcp-remote bridge)

summary: Local HTTP server that exposes Obsidian CLI commands as REST endpoints plus an MCP server so scripts and AI assistants can automate the vault.
